name: Sudden Flight
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 2, inquisitor 2, paladin 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V

EFFECT

Range personal
Duration 1 round + 1 round/3 levels

DESCRIPTION

You speak a forceful word of grace and speed and take flight. You gain a fly speed equal to your base land speed, with a good maneuverability, for one round plus one round per three caster levels you possess.
